title: One Gravity, Many G's: Generalized Horizon Entropy and Gravitational Susceptibility
summary: Effective and thermodynamic derivations of gravity theory in the context of generalized entropy can give rise to multiple, and potentially varying, gravitational couplings, raising the question of which quantity should be identified with the physically measured Newton constant. Motivated by this ambiguity, we formulate the notion of gravitational susceptibility of the horizon.
